title: Bug: Orchagent crashes when Vlan add is followed by Vlan del if del is received while add is enqueued
author: dgsudharsan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

This issue happens when we get add, followed by del. Due to the optimization in orchagent processing if we get del event for the same key where there is add event, the add event will be skipped

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/71219b0d41321093de633d5523b5e81eb7f34077/orchagent/orch.cpp#L175

```
2025-07-29.03:33:01.718992|VLAN_TABLE:Vlan1234|SET|admin_status:up|mtu:9100|mac:50:00:e6:23:f6:80|host_ifname:
2025-07-29.03:33:03.189874|VLAN_TABLE:Vlan1234|DEL
2025-07-29.03:33:06.404777|ROUTE_TABLE:fd00::/80|DEL
2025-07-29.03:33:06.405223|VLAN_TABLE:Vlan1234|DEL
```

This results in error logs and in versions before 202505 orchagent will crash

```
2025 Jul 29 03:33:06.406115 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_sai_validate_oid: oid is set to null object id on SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_VLAN
2025 Jul 29 03:33:06.406129 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeVlan: Failed to remove VLAN  vid:0
2025 Jul 29 03:33:06.406129 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- handleSaiRemoveStatus: Encountered failure in remove operation, exiting orchagent, SAI API: SAI_API_VLAN, status: SAI_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
2025 Jul 29 03:33:06.406145 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- notifySyncd: sending syncd: SYNCD_INVOKE_DUMP
2025 Jul 29 03:33:06.407508 sonic INFO syncd#SDK: :- processSingleEvent: key: SYNCD_INVOKE_DUMP op: notify
```

### Steps to Reproduce

It can be easily reproduced by attaching orchagent to gdb and executing the below commands

config vlan add 10
config vlan remove 10

Now detatch orchagent from gdb

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Errors are seen. Orchagent crashes in versions before 202505.

Expected behavior: No crash or errors.

linkedPullRequests.title: [orchagent]: Fix VLAN removal error after SET + DEL during orchagent …
linkedPullRequests.author: yizhenzha
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23506

## Root Cause

When orchagent is paused, a VLAN add+delete causes `ProducerStateTable` Lua scripts to coalesce SET+DEL into only DEL at the Redis layer, because `KEY_SET` is a Redis SET (no duplicates) and [luaDel](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss-common/blob/1e0584c4ab22924ffa8438985474389af81187b3/common/producerstatetable.cpp#L78-L81) destroys the state hash written by [luaSet](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss-common/blob/1e0584c4ab22924ffa8438985474389af81187b3/common/producerstatetable.cpp#L73). When orchagent resumes, [pops()](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss-common/blob/1e0584c4ab22924ffa8438985474389af81187b3/common/consumerstatetable.cpp#L84-L88) reads empty fields and interprets it as DEL. Orchagent then calls `removeVlan()` with an uninitialized Port (vid:0), causing `sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeVlan: Failed to remove VLAN  vid:0`.

**Sequence:** pause orchagent → `config vlan add 1024` → `config vlan del 1024` → resume orchagent

**Result:** vlanmgrd sent both SET and DEL to APPL_DB, but orchagent received only DEL (SET coalesced away at Lua/Redis layer).

## Fix

We can either fix this at the Lua/Redis layer or in orchagent after it consumes from Redis. This PR applies the fix in the orchagent layer.

In `portsorch.cpp:doVlanTask()`, if the VLAN does not exist in `m_portList`, skip the removal and erase the task from `m_toSync`.

### Validation of Fix on Switch

**Sequence:** pause orchagent → `config vlan add 123` → `config vlan del 123` → resume orchagent
```
2026 Mar 19 03:36:08.936401 sonic WARN swss#orchagent: :- doVlanTask: VLAN Vlan123 not found in m_portList, skipping removal (likely never created)
```
- vlanmgrd sent both SET and DEL to APPL_DB
- Orchagent received only DEL (SET coalesced at Lua/Redis layer)
- Fix detected Vlan123 was never created in ASIC, skipped SAI removal
- No `sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeVlan: Failed to remove VLAN  vid:0` error
